guard.note: finalizeSpawn: variant; for NATURAL / CHUNK_GENERATION with BAITFISH_SCHOOL_SPAWNING: count = (int)(getMaxSchoolSize() * random.nextFloat()) (the wrapped call), then per member a new Baitfish at 3 random offsets, startFollowing, addFreshEntity

tome_of_wonders_baitfish_school_cap.conversion: Trade-off, off by default: MixinExtras @ModifyExpressionValue on the m_6031_ (getMaxSchoolSize) call inside Baitfish.finalizeSpawn returns min(value, cap); cap = PureConfig.intValue("tome_of_wonders_baitfish_school_cap", 24, 0, 72) (72 = the original). Runtime flag tomeOfWondersBaitfishSchoolCap. Helper bons.furious.patch.tome_of_wonders_coo49.TowSchools.
tome_of_wonders_baitfish_school_cap.license: MIT (Tome of Wonders): no Tome of Wonders code is carried; the hook caps one value

guard.note: count = (int)(20 * random.nextFloat()); if not client: per member new Squill(SQUILL, level()), moveTo 3 random offsets, level().addFreshEntity(member) (the wrapped call; its answer is popped)
finalizeSpawn: NATURAL or CHUNK_GENERATION: move to the spawn height, spawnSchool when SQUILL_SCHOOL_SPAWNING (CHUNK_GENERATION runs on a world generation worker)

tome_of_wonders_squill_school_main_threa.conversion: Fix: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the Level.addFreshEntity call in Squill.spawnSchool: off the server thread the add is handed to MinecraftServer.execute and the call answers true (the answer is popped); on the server thread the original. Runtime flag tomeOfWondersSquillSchoolMainThread. Helper bons.furious.patch.tome_of_wonders_coo49.TowSchools.
tome_of_wonders_squill_school_main_threa.license: MIT (Tome of Wonders): no Tome of Wonders code is carried; the hook moves one call to the server thread
